def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError("Input must be numpy arrays")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("Input must be 2D matrices")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError("Input matrices cannot be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError("All entries must be finite")
        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
            raise ValueError("All entries must be nonpositive")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have same shape")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("Boolean threshold is invalid")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")

    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Weighted negative log-probabilities (i.e., losses)
    L_plus = -np.sum(weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_empty = -np.sum(weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)

    L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
    margins = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margins >= tau_filter

    return keep, margins
